races.name: FITZ AGRIPLANT Maiden

runners_data.name: Valentino Eclipse
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner from powerful Stack stable making debut, half-brother to stable's previous 6f juvenile winners
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to three winners, this looks like a weak maiden for this venue, could feature
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-brother to three winners, including two 6f juvenile scorers for this stable Thunder Eclipse and Eclipse Emerald (also won in Hong Kong later); unraced dam closely related to 2m Group 3 winner Dee Ex Bee, out of a sister to outstanding Dubai Millennium; hooded for debut.

runners_data.name: Caislean Ni Cuan
runners_data.note: Unraced hold-up type with strong Teofilo family connections, Thomas Mullins having quiet spell
runners_data.comment: First foal; dam once-raced half-sister to two winners, out of a winning sister to Teofilo
runners_data.spotlight: E16,000 yearling; first foal; dam once-raced half-sister to two winners, out of 7f-winning sister to unbeaten champion juvenile Teofilo.

runners_data.name: Gilts
runners_data.note: Mid-division runner on debut who showed inexperience, 21 days since disappointing Curragh run
runners_data.comment: Not a bad run in midfield at the Curragh on debut, likely to need more experience
runners_data.spotlight: Not a bad run in midfield at the Curragh on debut; likely to need more experience.

runners_data.name: Carmel Valley
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with consistent but moderate form, better ground conditions may help improvement
runners_data.comment: Modest form on only start at two and on reappearance, better ground may help her cause
runners_data.spotlight: Similar form at the Curragh on her only start at two and on reappearance at Limerick; needs to find extra; better ground may help.

runners_data.name: Goomah
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner returning after 226-day break, likely to dictate proceedings from the front

runners_data.name: Halon Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner showing gradual improvement, stable in good form recently across codes
runners_data.comment: Made debut over 1m2f, showed improvement over 1m at Bellewstown but well beaten in fourth
runners_data.spotlight: Made debut over 1m2f; showed improvement over 1m at Bellewstown but soundly beaten in fourth; several of the stable's Flat and jumps runners have run well recently.

runners_data.name: Khafar
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with Newbury second to impressive winner, 216 days off may need this run
runners_data.comment: Made an encouraging debut at Newbury, doubts raised by poor AW efforts, Shadwell cast-off
runners_data.spotlight: Despite showing inexperience, she shaped quite well in chasing home an impressive winner on her Newbury debut last August; favourite when some way below that level at Kempton on her second start; Wolverhampton run looked too bad to be true, but no excuses were put forward; 24,000gns Shadwell cast-off; risky, but the bar is set low for her Irish debut.

runners_data.name: Connecteo
runners_data.note: Hold-up type failed badly in two Dundalk starts, now gelded but transformation required
runners_data.comment: Failed to make any impact in two Dundalk outings at two, gelded now, transformation needed
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to make any impact in two Dundalk outings at two; gelded now; transformation needed.

runners_data.name: Cosmic Funk
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner beaten comprehensively in two recent Gowran efforts, handicap material
runners_data.comment: Well beaten in two Gowran outings in recent weeks, possibly one for handicaps after this
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in two Gowran outings in recent weeks; possibly one for handicaps after this.

runners_data.name: Threebiggulps
runners_data.note: Slow-starting hold-up horse with poor record, started poorly at Dundalk last time
runners_data.comment: No early signs of winning potential in races over 1m at Dundalk and 6f at the Curragh
runners_data.spotlight: Started slowly and never in contention over 1m at Dundalk; down the field over 6f at the Curragh.

races.paceDynamic: Goomah is the standout early pace angle, likely to lead uncontested with her prominent style and previous front-running tendencies. The lack of other natural pace pressers means she can dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages at Leopardstown's 7f trip. Behind her, the prominent runners Halon Bay will sit close, while the majority including Valentino Eclipse, Khafar, Connecteo, Cosmic Funk and Threebiggulps will settle towards the rear. This sets up perfectly for hold-up horses who can finish strongly, as the lack of pace pressure allows closers to unleash their best finish in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Setup
scenarios.trigger: If Goomah sets uncontested fractions and the field remains bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows hold-up horses to time their runs perfectly, with stamina and class telling in the final 2f. Quality closers with tactical speed will sweep past the tiring leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Goomah gets away with very easy fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: Her class advantage combined with a perfect tactical scenario allows her to build an unassailable lead. The closers are left with too much to do despite the moderate early pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is so slow that it becomes a sprint finish from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes purely about who has the most natural speed rather than stamina, favoring horses with early pace who can quicken. Those settling too far back get caught flat-footed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lightly-raced runners shows significant improvement from their debut runs
scenarios.body: Hidden ability emerges in the testing Leopardstown finish, with connections having worked on debut weaknesses. Experience proves less important than natural talent.

watchPoints.text: Goomah returning from 226-day layoff - watch for signs of ring-rustiness or fitness concerns in preliminary
Valentino Eclipse and Caislean Ni Cuan both making debuts - market moves will indicate stable confidence levels
Several hold-up horses including Connecteo and Cosmic Funk have shown fade-in-finish patterns recently
Wayne Lordan's positioning of Goomah in the early stages will dictate the entire pace scenario
Watch for any late market support for the Stack newcomer Valentino Eclipse given stable's 6f juvenile record

races.name: Captain Dara Fitzpatrick Memorial Maiden

runners_data.name: Almazann
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who showed clear improvement when step up in trip to 10.5f, with similar going experience working in his favour today.
runners_data.comment: Promising start when beaten a head at Cork, bred to relish this longer trip, big player
runners_data.spotlight: Promising start to career with a head second at Cork (10.5f, gd-yld) when sent off the 9-4 favourite; step up to this longer trip looks almost certain to suit on breeding; big player.

runners_data.name: Count Bezukhov
runners_data.note: Debut runner from strong O'Brien yard with excellent recent strike-rate, bred to appreciate middle-distances from top-class German Oaks winning dam.
runners_data.comment: Wootton Bassett colt, dam German Oaks winner, McMonagle prefers stablemate
runners_data.spotlight: Wootton Bassett colt; unsold for E125,000 as a yearling; dam 1m-11.6f winner (inc 2yo/AW/Group 1 German Oaks; RPR 103), closely related to French 1m winner Mia Sunshine, half-sister to smart 7f-8.6f winner Kingdom Come; nicely bred but McMonagle prefers stablemate.

runners_data.name: Dunmore
runners_data.note: First-time starter with outstanding pedigree including Group 2 winning half-brother Armande, representing yard with moderate recent form.
runners_data.comment: Palace Pier gelding, dam Listed winner, lots to like on paper, check the market
runners_data.spotlight: Palace Pier gelding; E33,000 yearling; half-brother to five winners inc Armande (1m2f/10.5f inc Group 2; RPR 113), Ambivalence (1m inc 2yo; 105), Alpine Spirit (7f; 88) and Rapture's Delight (7f; 84); dam 9.5f AW 2yo and 11.5f turf Listed winner (95); plenty to like on paper and worth a market check.

runners_data.name: Cannes
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with two consistent seconds, likely to get uncontested lead and dictate proceedings throughout.

runners_data.name: Glen Echo
runners_data.note: Showed nothing on debut at longer trip and rated significantly below these rivals, hard to recommend.
runners_data.comment: 40-1 and never involved on debut at Navan, can only be watched for now
runners_data.spotlight: 40-1 and never involved on debut at Navan (1m2f, gd-yld) last month; can only be watched upped in trip.

runners_data.name: Amethyst Stone
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who fades in finish, poorly rated and likely outclassed by this field.
runners_data.comment: 50-1 and never figured on debut at Navan last month, may need more time
runners_data.spotlight: 50-1 and always near the back when soundly beaten in a Navan maiden last month; may need more time.

runners_data.name: Mighty Wave
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who showed improvement last time when dropped back in trip, needs strong pace to be effective.
runners_data.comment: Modest debut run, stayed on well over 1m latest, up in trip, better ground could suit
runners_data.spotlight: Modest run on debut at the Curragh (1m2f, sft-hvy); much better last time dropped back to 1m at Gowran when a staying-on 2.75l third of 10; steps up in trip and, given his sire, could improve for faster ground; place claims.

runners_data.name: Antigua
runners_data.note: Prominent runner prone to fading in finish, has struggled to build on early promise across multiple starts.
runners_data.comment: Modest form last year, step forward on seasonal return, more needed; cheekpieces on
runners_data.spotlight: Didn't show a whole lot in two starts last year; step in the right direction on seasonal return here last month (1m2f, yld-sft) but was still beaten 6.5l into fourth; longer trip and new cheekpieces need to eke out more.

races.paceDynamic: Cannes appears the only confirmed early leader in this small field, likely to dictate terms from the front without serious pressure. Almazann and Antigua may track in behind as prominent racers, but neither showed urgency to lead in recent runs. The moderate pace setup will allow Cannes to control fractions and potentially kick clear, while the two newcomers Count Bezukhov and Dunmore remain complete unknowns tactically. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace, as there's insufficient early speed to create a strong gallop that would suit hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Cannes Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Cannes gets an easy lead and dictates moderate fractions uncontested.
scenarios.body: The Joseph O'Brien runner can kick clear turning for home with stamina reserves intact, making full use of his front-running style. Almazann's prominent style gives him the best chance of chasing down any breakaway from his tracking position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Newcomer Spring Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Count Bezukhov or Dunmore shows immediate pace and class on debut.
scenarios.body: The pedigrees suggest both newcomers have serious ability, and if either breaks smartly they could utilise the weak pace to establish position. Their fresh legs and potential class edge could prove decisive over these exposed maidens.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes even slower than expected creating a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: A crawling pace would negate Cannes's front-running advantage and bring stamina types into play. Mighty Wave showed staying-on ability last time and could benefit from a truly-run finish over this longer trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Cannes fails to lead or encounters trouble, leaving no genuine pace-setter.
scenarios.body: Without Cannes's confirmed front-running, this becomes a messy tactical affair where positioning becomes crucial. The race could develop into a stop-start affair favouring horses with tactical speed rather than pure stamina.

watchPoints.text: Watch Count Bezukhov's market moves and early positioning - any strong support or immediate pace-showing suggests serious debut intent from the O'Brien stable.
Monitor if Cannes gets the expected uncontested lead - any early pressure could compromise his stamina reserves for the finish.
Check Dunmore's early market movement and paddock appearance as first-timer with strong middle-distance pedigree from quiet stable.
Observe Almazann's settling pattern - needs to track the pace closely rather than get too far back given the likely moderate gallop.
Watch for any late money on Mighty Wave if the pace looks slow - his hold-up style could benefit from a sprint finish.

races.name: Al Shira'aa Racing "Mutamakina" Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)

runners_data.name: City Of Memphis
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong recent form but needs to avoid the traffic issues that could develop 2f out
runners_data.comment: Won at Gowran after a lengthy absence, left an impression she can go on to better things
runners_data.spotlight: Looked an exciting prospect when bolting up in Cork maiden last May; thrown straight into Group 1 company in the Irish 1,000 Guineas and acquitted herself very well, beaten 4 1/2l into fifth behind Lake Victoria, despite racing keenly; won over this trip at Gowran after a lengthy absence, leaving an impression she can go on to better things.

runners_data.name: Snellen
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 238-day break but has strong course record and tactical advantage
runners_data.comment: 2023 Chesham winner, won Group 3 over 1m1f last season after a fine Royal Ascot second
runners_data.spotlight: Winner of the 2023 Chesham; again ran well at Royal Ascot last year, second in 23-runner Kensington Palace Stakes; sprang a surprise in a four-runner 1m1f Group 3 at Leopardstown on penultimate start; this may be too sharp on reappearance.

runners_data.name: Fregada
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but has been off 224 days and stepping up significantly in class
runners_data.comment: Found wanting in two stakes races last year, this is ambitious for her seasonal debut
runners_data.spotlight: Found wanting in two stakes races last year; this is ambitious for her seasonal debut and first attempt at this trip.

runners_data.name: Princess Child
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner in excellent form with proven Group 3 ability at this distance
runners_data.comment: Five wins including a Group 3, solid display at a big price at the Curragh last month
runners_data.spotlight: Improved throughout the campaign last season, landing a competitive handicap at Galway over 7f and following up in Group 3 company at Tipperary before another good effort when fourth in Group 2 at Longchamp; beaten 6l into seventh at the Curragh on return; much better at the same venue six days later when a long-priced second in a 1m Group 3 event.

runners_data.name: Carla Ridge
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with good class but returning after long break could be vulnerable late
runners_data.comment: Ended last season with a stylish career-best in a 6f Listed race, can prosper at this trip
runners_data.spotlight: Ran well in defeat in Group 3 races on her first two outings last season; out of her depth in the Commonwealth Cup; subsequent stakes race form linked to the smart Sky Majesty was promising, and she ended the campaign with a stylish career-best in winning a 6f Curragh Listed race by 10l; can prosper at this trip.

runners_data.name: Quebec
runners_data.note: Prominent style but is second string from powerful stable behind Princess Child
runners_data.comment: Placed twice in Pattern races in Germany last season, useful recruit to a powerful team
runners_data.spotlight: Placed twice in Pattern races in Germany last season; useful recruit to a powerful team; however, she is the stable's second-string on this occasion.

runners_data.name: Duckadilly
runners_data.note: Prominent runner likely outclassed at this level despite Listed race experience
runners_data.comment: Second in a Listed race at Killarney last year, likely to find this company too demanding
runners_data.spotlight: Second in a Listed race at Killarney last year; likely to find this company too demanding, though worth noting she was aimed higher in the Matron Stakes.

runners_data.name: Signora
runners_data.note: Front-runner with 3-year-old allowance but significant class jump from recent victories

runners_data.name: Mallavelly
runners_data.note: Hold-up handicapper making stakes debut after 239-day absence, likely outpaced
runners_data.comment: Progressive in handicaps last year, sixth to Princess Child on her only stakes race outing
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive in handicaps last year; went up an aggregate 11lb for wins at this venue (1m) and at Tipperary; sixth to Princess Child on her only stakes race outing; ended the season with a fine third in a premier handicap over 1m here.

runners_data.name: California Dreamer
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner whose best form links well but needs to bounce back from poor recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Two wins on AW, 0-14 on turf, held by Princess Child on last month's Curragh running
runners_data.spotlight: Dual AW winner; stand-out turf display was her second to Lake Victoria in Irish 1,000 Guineas (City Of Memphis fifth); failed to go on from that run last season, and now 0-14 on turf; pleasing return to action when landing 1m conditions race at Dundalk; held by Princess Child on last month's Curragh running.

races.paceDynamic: Signora will lead from the gates with no early pressure, setting a comfortable rhythm in what should be an even gallop. City Of Memphis, Carla Ridge, Quebec and Duckadilly all want prominent positions, creating congestion and traffic problems turning for home when the pace lifts. The real danger comes from the hold-up horses - Snellen, Princess Child, California Dreamer and Fregada - who can use their pace late if given racing room. This race shape strongly favours patient, hold-up runners who can deliver finishing kicks when the prominent runners start to tie up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates traffic problems and the pace stays even through halfway
scenarios.body: The leaders get swamped by late-running types who saved ground and energy. Snellen and Princess Child are perfectly positioned to exploit the tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Escapes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the handy runners can slip the field turning for home before the hold-up horses get organized
scenarios.body: City Of Memphis or Carla Ridge could steal a decisive advantage if they avoid the traffic jam. Their class tells once clear.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Signora goes too fast early or gets pressured by the prominent group chasing
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the best horse on the day wins regardless of position. Princess Child's Group 3 form makes her dangerous.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Signora Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the leader can dictate fractions and the prominent runners fail to organize a serious challenge
scenarios.body: The 3-year-old gets an easy lead and kicks clear when the pressure comes. Her recent 7f wins suggest she can handle this class jump.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems in the home straight when City Of Memphis, Carla Ridge, Quebec and Duckadilly all converge from prominent positions
Monitor if Signora gets pressured early by the prominent group as she needs to dictate her own fractions
Check how quickly Snellen travels into contention given her 238-day layoff but strong historical course form
Watch for Princess Child getting a clear run as she has the form to win this if getting racing room late
Observe if California Dreamer can reproduce her Irish 1000 Guineas second form after disappointing follow-ups

races.name: Porsche In Support Of Breast Cancer Ireland Amethyst Stakes (Listed Race)

runners_data.name: Excellent Believe
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong recent form who should get an ideal stalking trip behind the lone leader
runners_data.comment: Placed in stakes company final two runs last season, strip fitter for comeback, respected
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time winner signed off last season with excellent placed efforts in a Haydock Group 3 (1m, good) and a Listed event at Craon (1m, very soft); not disgraced behind Docklands in Listed Doncaster Mile on seasonal return; sharper for that and this British raider is respected.

runners_data.name: Mutasarref
runners_data.note: Course specialist with four wins at Leopardstown who races prominently and handles all conditions
runners_data.comment: Four course wins, behind a couple of these latest but will strip fitter now, place shout
runners_data.spotlight: Has won ten of his 30 starts, including four times at this venue at 7f-1m; most recent success came at Cork in October 2024 (1m, yielding) but ran some fine races last season, including when third in this; well behind a couple of these on seasonal return here last month but better expected now with that run under his belt; place chance.

runners_data.name: Alcantor
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front-runner returning after 218 days but likely to get uncontested lead in small field

runners_data.name: Catalina Delcarpio
runners_data.note: Prominent racer stepping back in trip with 3lb weight allowance and strong recent Ascot form
runners_data.comment: Smart stakes form last season, won maiden over 1m2f here, yard in hot form, 1m a query
runners_data.spotlight: Won 1m2f filles' maiden here on debut (good); subsequently placed in Navan Group 3 (1m2f, soft) and in Group 2 Ribblesdale Stakes at Ascot (1m4f, gd-fm) when the 2-1 favourite; testing ground may not have suited on seasonal return in the Park Express at the Curragh (1m, sft-hvy); should improve for that and yard red-hot, but needs to prove effectiveness for this trip.

runners_data.name: Lord Massusus
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won at this course last year but needs stronger pace than likely here
runners_data.comment: Two-time C&D winner, improving for each run this season but a fair amount to find
runners_data.spotlight: Confirmed his liking for this venue when winning a Listed race here last season (Mutasarref a neck behind), his second C&D win; improving for each outing this season and should run his race but a rating of 99 leaves him with a fair amount to find with a few of these rivals.

runners_data.name: Mississippi River
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with course-and-distance win who showed promise on seasonal return
runners_data.comment: C&D winner last year, solid effort here on return, rated 100, needs to find a bit more
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time winner including a rated race last June over C&D (good); promising effort on seasonal return over C&D when 3l fifth to stablemate The Lion In Winter in the Listed Heritage Stakes, half a length behind Tokenomics and just in front of Lord Massusus; rated 100 and improvement is required.

runners_data.name: Omni Man
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 21-day break who needs strong gallop to be effective
runners_data.comment: Two wins last season and listed placed at Dundalk, 1m may prove too sharp
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins last season including a Goodwood handicap off 93 (1m4f, good); signed off with a Listed third at Dundalk (10.5f); slowly away and never involved on return at the Curragh (1m2f, soft); this ground much more his bag but not certain that the drop back to 1m will suit and overlooked by McMonagle.

runners_data.name: Tokenomics
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who needs pace to aim at but trainer David Marnane winless in last 10 runners
runners_data.comment: Had three of these behind over C&D latest, a bit to find on figures but could go very well
runners_data.spotlight: Course handicap winner at 1m1f; cracking effort when 2.5l fourth in Listed Heritage Stakes over C&D (yld-sft) last month when he had three of these behind despite not getting the clearest of runs; acts on good ground and seems to be improving; a bit to find on the figures, but could go very well.

races.paceDynamic: Alcantor is the only confirmed front-runner in this small field and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable pace without pressure from the prominent runners Excellent Believe, Mutasarref, and Catalina Delcarpio who are likely to track behind. The hold-up horses Lord Massusus, Omni Man, and Tokenomics will need the pace to be strong enough to set up their finishing kicks, but with just one leader, the tempo may be too modest. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the lone leader and strike in the straight, with the front-runner also holding chances if the pace stays controlled.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Alcantor sets an uncontested lead with the prominently-raced horses settling behind
scenarios.body: The modest gallop allows the leader to stay strong while prominent runners get first run on the lone pacesetter. Hold-up horses find insufficient pace to wind up effectively from the back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet applies enough pressure to soften up Alcantor's kick
scenarios.body: Excellent Believe, Mutasarref or Catalina Delcarpio get ideal trips tracking the leader before striking decisively. The controlled pace still doesn't suit the hold-up brigade but allows prominent runners to time their moves perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely testing with prominent runners pushing forward
scenarios.body: A stronger gallop sets up the race for Lord Massusus, Omni Man or Tokenomics to produce their best finishing efforts. The increased pace plays into the hands of horses that need something to aim at in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Alcantor gets completely uncontested fractions and the field settles too far back
scenarios.body: The leader maintains enough in reserve to hold off all challengers despite their late charges. Prominent runners leave their moves too late while hold-up horses have too much ground to make up.

watchPoints.text: Alcantor could steal this if the pace becomes too conservative and nobody challenges the leader early enough
Lord Massusus and the other hold-up horses may struggle if the pace stays modest with just one leader
Excellent Believe's prominent style and recent form make him well-suited to this likely race shape
Mississippi River needs to overcome a disappointing last run but has course form and Aidan O'Brien's string improving
Watch for any early pressure on Alcantor from the prominent runners as this will determine the pace scenario

races.name: Cashel Palace Hotel Derby Trial Stakes (Group 3)

runners_data.name: Endorsement
runners_data.note: Strong recent form including narrow defeat to Pierre Bonnard, well-suited by prominent racing style
runners_data.comment: Twice behind Pierre Bonnard last season, good front-running effort in the C&D Ballysax
runners_data.spotlight: Chased home the current Derby favourite Benvenuto Cellini on debut at the Curragh; won a maiden at Tipperary before second to Pierre Bonnard in the Zetland Stakes; made the running for Pierre Bonnard at Saint-Cloud before fading; same role in the Ballysax here four weeks ago; proved himself a smart type in his own right, sticking to his task as Pierre Bonnard flopped.

runners_data.name: Pierre Bonnard
runners_data.note: Highest-rated runner with proven Group class who should get ideal tracking position behind the leader
runners_data.comment: Group 1 winner at two, needs to rebuild his reputation after tame eclipse in the Ballysax
runners_data.spotlight: Beat Shaihann in a 1m Dundalk maiden last August; looked smart on his final two juvenile starts; asserted strongly when beating stablemate Endorsement in the Zetland Stakes (1m2f, good to firm); readily beat A Boy Named Susie on very soft ground in the Criterium de Saint-Cloud; now needs to rebuild his reputation after tame eclipse in the Ballysax

runners_data.name: Straight Up
runners_data.note: Hold-up style less suited to small field dynamics, though headgear suggests connections expect improvement
runners_data.comment: Making up the numbers for Ballydoyle here, hooded after disappointing seasonal debut
runners_data.spotlight: Justified favouritism in a Listowel festival maiden (7f, heavy); may not have been suited by quick ground in the Group 3 Autumn Stakes at Newmarket; hooded after disappointing seasonal debut; making up the numbers for Ballydoyle here.

runners_data.name: James J Braddock
runners_data.note: Sole front-runner gives him tactical control but faces significant class disadvantage against Ballydoyle pair
runners_data.comment: Got outpaced in the Ballysax, kept on late in fifth, around 3l behind Endorsement
runners_data.spotlight: Promising Navan debut when strong-finishing 1/2l second over 1m, despite rider losing an iron close home; impressed in beating two stablemates in testing conditions in a 1m Curragh maiden at the beginning of November; got outpaced in the Ballysax on reappearance, kept on late in fifth, around 3l behind Endorsement.

runners_data.name: Shaihaan
runners_data.note: Proven heavy ground form could be asset if conditions play testing, though good going officially declared
runners_data.comment: Beat two subsequent winners in a 1m2f Curragh maiden, should hold his own  in this grade
runners_data.spotlight: Improved from his debut in a 7f course maiden dominated by Aidan O'Brien when chasing home Pierre Bonnard over 1m at Dundalk; found the competition too hot in the Group 2 Beresford Stakes; made a fine start to the season when beating two subsequent winners in a 1m2f Curragh maiden; not out of place in this company now that he is more mature.

races.paceDynamic: James J Braddock will dictate terms as the sole confirmed leader in this small field, setting a steady rhythm without pressure from fellow front-runners. The prominent runners Pierre Bonnard, Endorsement and Shaihaan will track within striking distance, while Straight Up sits closest. With no genuine pace pressure early, the tempo will be measured through the first mile before quickening from the 2f pole. This tactical setup strongly favours the prominent racers who can position handily behind the leader and have enough tactical speed to respond when the race develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the measured early pace allows the class horses to travel smoothly in behind James J Braddock
scenarios.body: Pierre Bonnard and Endorsement benefit most from their superior ratings and tactical positioning, with both able to quicken off the steady gallop. The Aidan O'Brien pair have the class edge and ideal racing room to settle this between them.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Braddock Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If James J Braddock's uncontested lead allows him to dictate fractions that suit his running style perfectly
scenarios.body: The Joseph O'Brien runner can utilise his superior fitness edge and tactical advantage to kick clear approaching the final furlong. His stamina-laden pedigree and front-running style become decisive assets in the testing final stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Shaihaan Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the Good going plays more testing than expected and Shaihaan's heavy ground form advantage becomes relevant
scenarios.body: The Donnacha O'Brien runner's proven ability in softer conditions gives him the edge as others struggle with the underfoot conditions. His recent Dundalk form with Pierre Bonnard looks stronger in this context.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Straight Up Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves even steadier than expected, setting up a sprint finish that suits hold-up horses
scenarios.body: Straight Up's proven turn of foot from off the pace becomes the decisive weapon in a slowly-run affair. The headgear and extended break could have him primed for a bold effort at rewarding odds.

watchPoints.text: James J Braddock's early fractions will determine if his class deficit can be overcome by tactical advantage
Pierre Bonnard's settling early will indicate if his class rating translates to tactical dominance
Straight Up's position turning for home reveals if the pace has been steady enough for his finishing kick
Endorsement's response to pressure will show if recent consistent form can translate to Group success
Shaihaan's travelling order indicates whether the going is playing as testing as his best form suggests

races.name: "It's Family Day At Leopardstown" Fillies Maiden

runners_data.name: Madam Justice
runners_data.note: Unknown quantity with prominent style and strong breeding connections, making debut for in-form jockey
runners_data.comment: Dam an unraced half-sister to very useful Hong Kong performer Stephensons Rocket
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth foal; half-sister to a middle distance winner in Italy; dam unraced half-sister to very useful Hong Kong performer Stephensons Rocket.

runners_data.name: My First Rose
runners_data.note: Unraced half-sister to stable winners, bred to appreciate this trip but trainer struggling for winners
runners_data.comment: Half-sister by Camelot to two winners, dam by Dubawi, won two 1m Listed races
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; half-sister by Camelot to two winners for this stable, Red Vibernum and Pierre Royal; dam, by Dubawi, won two 1m Listed races and is from a smart middle-distance family.

runners_data.name: Path To Peace
runners_data.note: Debutant with solid breeding for middle distances, trainer has 1 from 9 recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Sixth foal; half-sister to four winners; dam unplaced in France, out of a US stakes winner
runners_data.spotlight: Sixth foal; half-sister to four winners; dam unplaced in France, out of US 1m stakes winning half-sister to 6f 2yo Group 3 winner Bertolini.

runners_data.name: Wickedly Wootton
runners_data.note: Expensive yearling purchase making debut for trainer in good form with 6 from 11
runners_data.comment: Dam, by Galileo, won the 1m Group 2 Prix de Sandringham for Jean-Claude Rouget, noteworthy
runners_data.spotlight: E360,000 yearling; fourth foal; Wootton Bassett filly is closely related to Steel Tiger who stayed well for two AW wins in Britain; half-sister to two French winners; dam, by Galileo, won the 1m Group 2 Prix de Sandringham for Jean-Claude Rouget, out of Nunthorpe winner Margot Did.

runners_data.name: Beatific
runners_data.note: Prominent runner building on encouraging debut fifth, benefits from similar going conditions
runners_data.comment: Frankel filly should be capable of building on a debut fifth over 1m here four weeks ago
runners_data.spotlight: Frankel filly should be capable of building on a debut fifth over 1m here four weeks ago; runner-up Thundering On (beaten favourite then) gave the form a boost when winning a Group 3 event at Naas.

runners_data.name: Pink Coral
runners_data.note: Prominent type who ran behind stablemate last time, 25 days since last run suits
runners_data.comment: Behind a longer-priced stablemate on debut, improvement is on the cards, cheekpieces tried
runners_data.spotlight: Wootton Bassett filly; finished behind a longer-priced stablemate (who was third) when fifth in a nine-runner C&D maiden last month; improvement on the cards; cheekpieces tried.

runners_data.name: Believed
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with Gold Trip connections, showed rawness on AW debut but step up in trip helps
runners_data.comment: Looked raw when fourth on debut in a 1m maiden at Dundalk, form has been boosted
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister by Frankel to four winners, notably 2022 Melbourne Cup hero Gold Trip; looked raw when fourth on debut in a 1m maiden at Dundalk, beaten around 7l; form has been boosted by wins for the second and third; extra two furlongs should suit; hooded.

runners_data.name: Johanna Walsh
runners_data.note: Staying-on type who has shown promise in two starts, handles the going conditions
runners_data.comment: Promising when third behind a longer-priced stablemate at Gowran a month ago
runners_data.spotlight: Sea The Stars filly; cost E460,000 as a yearling; ran green on debut at Thurles last October, showed promise with a staying-on third, 3/4l off runner-up Cape Primrose; reversed form with that rival when third behind a longer-priced stablemate at Gowran a month ago.

runners_data.name: Wedding
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who made late progress last time, lost stable jockey to stablemate
runners_data.comment: Made some late progress when fifth in a seven-runner maiden at Gowran, can improve
runners_data.spotlight: E350,000 yearling; made some late progress when fifth in a seven-runner maiden at Gowran; Wayne Lordan, who rode her then, stays loyal to Pink Coral instead.

runners_data.name: Zitkala Sa
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner but moderate recent form, will get uncontested lead
runners_data.comment: Moderate efforts in maidens at Dundalk and Limerick last month, up against it here
runners_data.spotlight: Moderate efforts in maidens at Dundalk and Limerick last month; up against it here.

runners_data.name: Jerpoint Abbey
runners_data.note: Hold-up 4-year-old stepping up from bumpers, breeding suggests turf improvement possible
runners_data.comment: Reported to have made an abnormal respiratory noise in a bumper at Punchestown
runners_data.spotlight: Justify filly was a USD275,000 yearling purchase; not bred with Irish winter heavy ground in mind but made a fair debut in a bumper at Naas in January; reported to have made an abnormal respiratory noise in a bumper at the Punchestown festival; hood added to tongue-tie worn then.

races.paceDynamic: Zitkala Sa will be the sole confirmed early leader in this 11-runner fillies' maiden, setting what should be a sustainable gallop without early pressure. The prominent runners Beatific, Pink Coral and Johanna Walsh will track behind, while the hold-up horses Believed, Wedding and Jerpoint Abbey will need the pace to collapse late. With only one natural front-runner and several prominent types content to sit handy, this sets up as a moderate early pace that should quicken significantly from the 3f pole. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and strike when the pace lifts, rather than hold-up horses who will need everything to fall right.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace allows prominent runners to position perfectly behind Zitkala Sa
scenarios.body: The likes of Beatific, Pink Coral and Johanna Walsh get ideal tracking positions and have too much tactical speed for the hold-up horses when the race develops. The sustained gallop from 3f out suits their profiles perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Debutant Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If one of the well-bred newcomers Madam Justice, My First Rose, Path To Peace or Wickedly Wootton shows significant improvement
scenarios.body: The moderate pace suits a newcomer with natural ability who can sit prominent and quicken. Their lack of exposed form becomes an advantage in a race where the exposed runners have limitations.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Zitkala Sa sets a stronger pace than expected or the prominent runners go too hard tracking her
scenarios.body: The increased early tempo sets up perfectly for Believed, Wedding or Jerpoint Abbey to come from off the pace. Their late kick proves decisive as the early leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Zitkala Sa gets completely uncontested fractions and the field fails to organize a proper challenge
scenarios.body: Despite her moderate form, Zitkala Sa gets such an easy time in front that she can repel the late challenges. The lack of early pressure allows her to save enough for the finish.

watchPoints.text: Zitkala Sa gets completely uncontested fractions in the first half-mile which could allow her to steal it
Any of the four debutants Madam Justice, My First Rose, Path To Peace or Wickedly Wootton showing market confidence
Beatific and Pink Coral both being strongly supported as the most proven prominent runners
Jerpoint Abbey's transition from bumpers to flat racing and how she handles the pace
The positioning of hold-up horses Believed and Wedding if the early pace is genuinely moderate

races.name: Leopardstown Golf, Padel, Range Handicap

runners_data.name: Akecheta
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist suited by honest pace, trainer struggles with 0/12 record but horse has winning form on good ground
runners_data.comment: Well supported in two of her three races this term, not yet running to expectations
runners_data.spotlight: Gained second heavy-ground win in conditions race at Gowran (7f) last September; yet to win a handicap; well supported in two of her three races this term, including the Irish Lincoln; has not run to expectations, but perhaps premature to write off.

runners_data.name: Candleford Green
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from long break, Mullins 17/122 strike rate provides confidence despite 202-day absence
runners_data.comment: Lighly-raced filly, fair chance she can pay her way in handicaps this season
runners_data.spotlight: Touched off at this venue on her only start at two; beaten favourite on her reappearance last spring;  made amends on the second of two starts in the autumn, stuck to her task (despite hanging to the right) to land a heavy-ground maiden over a bit shorter than this at Gowran; fair chance she can pay her way in handicaps this season.

runners_data.name: Truth Be Told
runners_data.note: Strong stayer who won over 1m4f last time, benefits from step back up in trip and guaranteed early pace
runners_data.comment: Winner over 1m4f, this may not be far enough to bring out the best in him
runners_data.spotlight: Appreciated the step up in trip to 1m4f-plus when winning at Thurles on his final start last season; ex-Dermot Weld; further improvement possible for his new trainer; this may not be far enough to bring out the best in him.

runners_data.name: Ben Lawers
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse wearing tongue-tie, has place claims but may find Akecheta too strong on recent Cork form
runners_data.comment: AW winner over 1m, has a bit to find with Akecheta on running at Cork last time
runners_data.spotlight: AW winner over 1m, has a bit to find with Akecheta on running at Cork last time; trainer may have a better chance with Diamond Exchange.

runners_data.name: Sonoran
runners_data.note: Prominent racer whose form has declined since juvenile success, needs to recapture early career promise
runners_data.comment: Things have gone downhill since starting his career with a win and a second
runners_data.spotlight: Won 7f Tipperary maiden and then second in a Cork conditions race in the first half of his juvenile season; things have gone downhill since then; hard to be confident.

runners_data.name: Ob La Di
runners_data.note: Prominent type suited by return to good ground after struggling on heavy, course and distance winner here
runners_data.comment: Not suited by heavy ground on her final two starts last season, in rear on soft on return
runners_data.spotlight: Won over this trip at Naas last August on good ground; not suited by heavy ground on her final two starts; in rear on soft on return.

runners_data.name: Dark Summit
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with concerning tendency to fade in finish, confidence dented by recent poor runs
runners_data.comment: Fair run in the Irish Lincoln on Irish debut, confidence dented by two more recent runs
runners_data.spotlight: French winner on good-to-soft (1m); shaped promisingly enough on debut for this yard in the Irish Lincoln; confidence dented by two more recent runs.

runners_data.name: Railwayview Lady
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 203-day break, upset winner last season but faces stiff task off long absence
runners_data.comment: Struggled on heavy ground on final start last year; that run can be forgiven
runners_data.spotlight: Sprang 125-1 shock in a 1m2f Navan maiden last September and proved that was no fluke later in the month when going down narrowly on handicap debut over 1m5f at Down Royal (yielding), still green; struggled on heavy ground on final start; that run can be forgiven.

runners_data.name: Glyndwr
runners_data.note: Prominent type better on all-weather, unchanged mark after course and distance win suggests competitive
runners_data.comment: Has won three of his four races at Dundalk, second on his most recent turf run, respected
runners_data.spotlight: Has won three of his four races at Dundalk; second over 1m at Bellewstown last August on his final turf run in 2025; respected with his mark unchanged after a claiming race win on AW last November.

runners_data.name: Spanish Rising
runners_data.note: Natural leader likely to press Diamond Exchange, second over course and distance gives hope

runners_data.name: Diamond Exchange
runners_data.note: Front runner who won here on all-weather, wears pacifiers and should dictate terms under claiming rider

runners_data.name: Genoah
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with two recent all-weather wins, question mark over turf form on good ground

runners_data.name: Kilcrea Rock
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from long break, showed promise at two but inconsistent since stepping up in trip
runners_data.comment: Second to a smart type over 1m at two, best form last year was over further than this
runners_data.spotlight: Promise in two runs at two, notably when second to the subsequent 2025 Irish Derby runner-up Serious Contender; uneven form last year, best efforts were over further than this.

races.paceDynamic: Diamond Exchange and Spanish Rising will engage from the off as both are natural front runners with recent form showing early speed. Diamond Exchange looks the more resolute of the pair having won at this venue on the all-weather and should dictate terms through honest fractions. The substantial hold-up contingent including Akecheta, Truth Be Told, Ben Lawers, and Genoah will be patient in rear, while prominent racers like Sonoran and Ob La Di settle just behind the pace. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can sit off the genuine early pace and finish with one sustained run.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Diamond Exchange and Spanish Rising maintain honest gallop without collapsing
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the rear division pay dividends as they sweep past tiring leaders in final furlong. Akecheta and Truth Be Told benefit most from their preferred waiting style combined with the guaranteed pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Diamond Exchange gets soft lead and quickens approaching final furlong
scenarios.body: Diamond Exchange capitalizes on tactical speed having settled better than Spanish Rising early on. The hold-up horses leave their challenge too late on the testing 1m2f trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Profit
scenarios.trigger: If early pace collapses and becomes messy crawl
scenarios.body: Horses positioned prominently like Ob La Di and Sonoran avoid trouble of slow pace that catches out both leaders and hold-up horses. They can quicken most effectively from their tracking positions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners fade badly leaving no pace on
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from 3f out benefiting those with natural finishing speed regardless of position. Dark Summit's fade tendency becomes less relevant in such circumstances.

watchPoints.text: Diamond Exchange getting uncontested lead as Spanish Rising fails to engage - removes pace advantage for hold-up horses
Truth Be Told and Akecheta both held up in same position creating traffic problems in run-in
Candleford Green and Railwayview Lady both returning from 200+ day breaks affecting fitness levels
Dark Summit getting prominent position early as his fade tendency becomes more pronounced over this trip
Weather conditions affecting good ground designation as consistent going reports suggest no change expected

races.name: Breast Cancer Ireland Handicap

runners_data.name: Bay Of Stars
runners_data.note: Only prominent runner who will control the pace but question marks over class level stepping up from Dundalk all-weather
runners_data.comment: Off mark stepped up to 1m4f on AW, bred to go on turf, rider takes off handy 5lb
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten 10l on debut over 1m at Dundalk last November; stepped up in trip and off the mark back there over 1m4f 17 days ago; no reason he won't be effective on turf (dam three-time winner on good ground) and rider takes off a handy 5lb; entered in the Irish Derby.

runners_data.name: Eniac
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up horse from powerful O'Brien stable with breeding suggesting this trip ideal and good form at Leopardstown
runners_data.comment: Best maiden run came here (1m), should stay this far, bred to be better than opening mark
runners_data.spotlight: Best of three maiden efforts came here over 1m last October (yielding); bred to be better than an opening mark of 78 and his dam won over 1m4f, so good chance he'll stay this far on handicap debut; yard amongst winners.

runners_data.name: Chestnut Palace
runners_data.note: Unproven hold-up type making handicap debut with modest maiden form and questionable trip suitability
runners_data.comment: Handicap debutante, just mild promise in maidens, this trip a query on breeding, watch
runners_data.spotlight: Just mild promise in three maiden runs within the space of a month; questionable whether this trip will suit on breeding; likely best watched on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Darius Dark
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who delivered on handicap debut but fading tendency and 16-day gap since Cork success concerning
runners_data.comment: Off the mark on h'cap debut latest, up 5lb, from talented family, may be more to come
runners_data.spotlight: Big prices all three maidens but sent off 11-2 on handicap debut at Cork (1m4f, gd-yld) and duly delivered a 0.5l win off 63 (Servare a 3.75l fifth); the third from that race has since hosed up in a maiden; raised 5lb but from a talented family and could be more to come.

runners_data.name: Divine Believer
runners_data.note: Hold-up style stepping up significantly in trip with only modest form but 3lb drop in weights provides assistance
runners_data.comment: No show in maidens or on h'cap debut latest, down 3lb but others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Modest maiden form; finished just ahead of Pass The Buck on handicap debut at the Curragh (1m, soft) last month; dropped 3lb and steps up markedly in trip; still early days but others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Servare
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up performer when winning at Navan but fading tendency evident and stalls issues at Cork last time
runners_data.comment: Won over 1m2f off 12lb lower at Navan, ok run off revised mark latest, cheekpieces on
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark on seasonal return at Navan in March (1m2f, heavy); upset in stalls when beaten 3.75l by Darius Dark off 12lb higher mark at Cork (gd-yld); can give a good account if the cheekpieces have a positive effect.

runners_data.name: Pass The Buck
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with recent 2-day gap potentially advantageous but fading pattern and only 1 place from 5 on good going

runners_data.name: Dreoilin
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up type from in-form Bolger yard with two solid seconds suggesting ready to strike in handicaps
runners_data.comment: Promise in both handicaps, good ground and 1m4f are queries, not discounted
runners_data.spotlight: Found just Servare too good when a 7l second on handicap debut at Navan (1m2f, heavy); went even closer when a 0.75l second at the Curragh last time (1m, soft, two of these behind); raised 3lb; good ground and this longer trip are unknowns.

runners_data.name: Keepsgettingbetter
runners_data.note: Progressive hold-up horse but 9lb rise harsh after Dundalk wins and 30-day absence potentially problematic
runners_data.comment: Raised 16lb for two Dundalk wins at 1m and 1m2f, this deeper, trip and turf queries
runners_data.spotlight: Has progressed since tackling handicaps; 0.5l win off 58 at Dundalk in March (1m) followed by a 2.25l win at the same venue in April off 65; up another 9lb now and this is a deeper race; has to prove she is effective on turf and at this longer trip (mixed messages in pedigree).

races.paceDynamic: Bay Of Stars will dictate the pace from prominent position with no genuine front-runners to pressure him, creating a sustainable tempo through the middle stages. The large field of hold-up horses including Eniac, Servare, and Darius Dark will track behind in a compressed pack. With good ground conditions over 1m4f at Leopardstown, this sets up perfectly for a sprint finish where positioning and timing become crucial. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks who can quicken late off the steady pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Late Kick Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains steady and the field stays bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: Bay Of Stars' modest pace allows the hold-up brigade to travel comfortably before unleashing finishing speed. The good ground and trip favour horses with turn of foot like Eniac and Servare who can quicken decisively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Bay Of Stars Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Bay Of Stars kicks clear turning in and the closers respond too late
scenarios.body: His recent Dundalk win suggests improved stamina and he gets first run on the field. The hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up despite their superior ratings.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Bay Of Stars weakens badly and creates a sprint from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: Multiple hold-up horses converge simultaneously in a blanket finish where race positioning proves decisive. Jockey judgement becomes paramount as traffic problems develop in the large field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses positions closer to the pace than usual
scenarios.body: A tactical switch catches the deep closers napping while avoiding Bay Of Stars' kickback. This suits a horse like Eniac or Servare if connections adopt more aggressive tactics.

watchPoints.text: Bay Of Stars breaking clear turning in could steal this if the hold-up horses are caught napping by the steady pace
Servare and Pass The Buck both showing fading tendencies in recent runs which could prove costly in a competitive finish
Eniac and Dreoilin both represent trainers with excellent recent form and could benefit from the expected strong pace
The large field of hold-up horses could create traffic problems in the straight affecting several chances
Divine Believer stepping up markedly in trip for the first time with breeding questions over the extended distance
